name: sorrel
desc: A market bread-seller in her forties who works a bread-window on a stair-street: quick-eyed and quick-smiling, warm olive skin, dark curly hair bound up in a rust-red kerchief with a few loose strands, small gold hoops in her ears, flour on her forearms. She wears a terracotta bodice over a cream linen shirt with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, a striped market apron with a coin pocket, and a wooden bread-paddle tucked under one arm. Transactional warmth: she is already pricing you.
sheetHint: dark curly hair in a rust-red kerchief, gold hoop earrings, terracotta bodice, cream shirt sleeves rolled, striped market apron with coin pocket, bread-paddle under arm
